name: Paladin Oath Against Maleficium (Paladin Oath)
body:
A paladin taking this oath is the sworn enemy of evil spellcasters. She may see all magic with suspicion, have a bias only against certain arcane or psychic dabblers (like witches or spiritualists), or be more open-minded and condemn the wicked use of magic rather than magic in itself.

A paladin with this oath doesn’t cast spells, nor receives oath spells.

Detect Evil Magic (Sp)

The paladin can use detect magic at will, but only to detect magic created with evil purposes. This otherwise functions as the detect evil ability. The paladin cannot use detect evil and detect evil magic at the same time.

Smite Evil Magic (Su)

This ability works like the standard paladin ability to smite evil, except the paladin deals additional damage to evil spellcasters instead of evil dragons. This also applies to evil monsters that can cast spells (not monsters with spell-like abilities) or have levels in spellcasting classes. If the target of smite evil magic is a spellcasting evil outsider or undead, the bonus to damage on the first successful attack increases to 3 points per level the paladin possesses.

This ability modifies smite evil.

Aura of Clarity (Su)

At 5th level, the paladin is immune to all possession spells and effects and to spells and effects that force a creature’s soul out of its body. Each ally within 10 feet of her gains a +4 morale bonus on saving throws against these effects.

This ability functions only while the paladin is conscious, not if she is unconscious or dead.

Mercy (Su)

The paladin must select the ensorcelled mercy at 12th level.

Resist Evil Magic (Su)

At 15th level, the paladin gains spell resistance equal to her paladin level +5. She can dismiss her resistance at will if she wishes to be affected by a spell.

Holy Purifier (Su)

At 20th level, whenever the paladin uses smite evil magic and successfully strikes an evil spellcaster, the spellcaster must succeed at a Will saving throw (DC = 10 + ½ the paladin’s level + her Charisma bonus) or lose the ability to cast spells for a number of rounds equal to the paladin’s level. This modifies and otherwise functions as holy champion.

Code of Conduct
Do not suffer the existence of evil magic in the world.
Dispel curses, undo evil spells, and convert or destroy any evil spellcaster you come upon.
